nodes.name: FP003-04 角色设定生成助手

parameters.query:
WITH request AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS value
), book_scope AS (
  SELECT b.id, b.intent_json, b.forbid_json, public.v7_design_editable(b.id) AS design_editable
  FROM public.book_project AS b
  JOIN request AS r
    ON b.id = (r.value->>'book_id')::uuid
   AND b.local_operator_id = (r.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
), runtime AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'node_code', b.node_code,
    'model_config_id', b.model_config_id,
    'model_config_version', b.model_config_version,
    'prompt_config_id', b.prompt_config_id,
    'prompt_version', b.prompt_version,
    'template_type', b.template_type,
    'temperature', b.temperature,
    'prompt_text', b.prompt_text,
    'prompt_status', b.prompt_status,
    'model_name', b.model_name,
    'provider_base_url', b.provider_base_url,
    'api_key_ref', b.api_key_ref,
    'routing_config_jsonb', b.routing_config_jsonb,
    'parameters_jsonb', b.parameters_jsonb
  ) AS binding
  FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS b
  JOIN request AS r
    ON b.local_operator_id = (r.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
  WHERE b.node_code = 'FP003-04'
    AND b.prompt_status = 'active'
    AND NULLIF(btrim(b.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(btrim(b.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(btrim(b.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(btrim(b.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY b.model_config_version DESC, b.prompt_version DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'book_exists', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM book_scope),
  'design_editable', COALESCE((SELECT design_editable FROM book_scope), false),
  'intent_json', COALESCE((SELECT intent_json FROM book_scope), '{}'::jsonb),
  'forbid_json', COALESCE((SELECT forbid_json FROM book_scope), '{}'::jsonb),
  'l1a_unit_candidates', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', id,
      'l1a_name', l1a_name,
      'conflict_background', conflict_background,
      'escalation_path', escalation_path,
      'stakes', stakes,
      'irreversible_consequence', irreversible_consequence,
      'plot_emotion_commit', plot_emotion_commit,
      'arc_requirement', arc_requirement,
      'info_reveal_boundary', info_reveal_boundary,
      'role_arc_json', role_arc_json
    ) ORDER BY l1a_index)
    FROM public.l1a_unit
    JOIN request AS r ON l1a_unit.book_id = (r.value->>'book_id')::uuid
    WHERE l1a_unit.status = 'candidate'
      AND l1a_unit.is_valid
      AND NOT l1a_unit.is_shadow
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'world_state', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'atom_key', atom_key,
      'atom_type', atom_type,
      'atom_value_jsonb', atom_value_jsonb,
      'affordance_dims', affordance_dims
    ) ORDER BY atom_key)
    FROM public.world_state
    JOIN request AS r ON world_state.book_id = (r.value->>'book_id')::uuid
    WHERE world_state.is_active
      AND world_state.is_formal
      AND world_state.is_valid
      AND NOT world_state.is_shadow
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'existing_characters', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', id,
      'char_name', char_name,
      'char_type', char_type,
      'five_layers_json', five_layers_json,
      'knowledge_boundary_json', knowledge_boundary_json,
      'arc_json', arc_json
    ) ORDER BY char_name)
    FROM public.character
    JOIN request AS r ON character.book_id = (r.value->>'book_id')::uuid
    WHERE character.is_active
      AND character.is_formal
      AND character.is_valid
      AND NOT character.is_shadow
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'runtime', COALESCE((SELECT binding FROM runtime), '{}'::jsonb)
) AS context;

nodes.name: 读世界设定和已有角色

parameters.query:
WITH request AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS value),
character_payload AS (
  SELECT item.value AS character,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(item.value->>'char_code', ''), item.value->>'client_ref') AS char_code
  FROM request, jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN request.value->>'action' = 'save_candidate' THEN request.value->'candidate'->'characters' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS item(value)
),
existing_characters AS (
  SELECT current.id, current.char_code
  FROM api.v_character_candidate_write AS current
  JOIN request AS request_scope
    ON current.book_id = (request_scope.value->>'book_id')::uuid
   AND current.local_operator_id = (request_scope.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
  JOIN character_payload AS payload
    ON payload.char_code = current.char_code
),
character_input AS (
  SELECT payload.character, payload.char_code, existing_character.id AS existing_character_id,
    COALESCE(existing_character.id, gen_random_uuid()) AS id
  FROM character_payload AS payload
  LEFT JOIN existing_characters AS existing_character
    ON existing_character.char_code = payload.char_code
),
character_update AS (
  UPDATE api.v_character_candidate_write AS current
  SET char_name = input.character->>'char_name',
      five_layers_json = input.character->'five_layers_json',
      knowledge_boundary_json = input.character->'knowledge_boundary_json',
      arc_json = input.character->'arc_json',
      is_active = true,
      char_type = input.character->>'char_type',
      char_code = input.char_code,
      gender = NULLIF(input.character->>'gender', '')
  FROM character_input AS input
  WHERE current.id = input.id
    AND input.existing_character_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING current.id
),
character_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO api.v_character_candidate_write (id, book_id, char_name, five_layers_json, knowledge_boundary_json, arc_json, is_active, char_type, char_code, gender, local_operator_id)
  SELECT input.id, (request.value->>'book_id')::uuid, input.character->>'char_name', input.character->'five_layers_json', input.character->'knowledge_boundary_json', input.character->'arc_json', true, input.character->>'char_type', input.char_code, NULLIF(input.character->>'gender', ''), (request.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
  FROM request CROSS JOIN character_input AS input
  WHERE input.existing_character_id IS NULL
  RETURNING id
),
character_write AS (
  SELECT id FROM character_update
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id FROM character_insert
),
relation_payload AS (
  SELECT item.value AS relation
  FROM request, jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN request.value->>'action' = 'save_candidate' THEN request.value->'candidate'->'relations' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS item(value)
),
relation_input AS (
  SELECT payload.relation,
    (SELECT id FROM character_input WHERE character->>'client_ref' = payload.relation->>'from_ref') AS char_a_id,
    (SELECT id FROM character_input WHERE character->>'client_ref' = payload.relation->>'to_ref') AS char_b_id
  FROM relation_payload AS payload
),
existing_relations AS (
  SELECT current.id, current.char_a_id, current.char_b_id
  FROM api.v_relation_candidate_write AS current
  JOIN request AS request_scope
    ON current.book_id = (request_scope.value->>'book_id')::uuid
   AND current.local_operator_id = (request_scope.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
  JOIN relation_input AS input
    ON input.char_a_id = current.char_a_id
   AND input.char_b_id = current.char_b_id
),
relation_update AS (
  UPDATE api.v_relation_candidate_write AS current
  SET char_a_id = input.char_a_id,
      char_b_id = input.char_b_id,
      trust = (input.relation->>'trust')::integer,
      intimacy = (input.relation->>'intimacy')::integer,
      power_balance = (input.relation->>'power_balance')::integer,
      dependence = (input.relation->>'dependence')::integer,
      hostility = (input.relation->>'hostility')::integer,
      common_goal = (input.relation->>'common_goal')::integer,
      secret_known = (input.relation->>'secret_known')::integer,
      emotional_bond = (input.relation->>'emotional_bond')::integer,
      relation_type = input.relation->>'relation_type',
      relation_hierarchy = input.relation->>'relation_hierarchy',
      change_event_json = input.relation->'change_event_json'
  FROM relation_input AS input
  JOIN existing_relations AS existing_relation
    ON existing_relation.char_a_id = input.char_a_id
   AND existing_relation.char_b_id = input.char_b_id
  WHERE current.id = existing_relation.id
  RETURNING current.id
),
relation_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO api.v_relation_candidate_write (id, book_id, char_a_id, char_b_id, trust, intimacy, power_balance, dependence, hostility, common_goal, secret_known, emotional_bond, relation_type, relation_hierarchy, change_event_json, local_operator_id)
  SELECT gen_random_uuid(), (request.value->>'book_id')::uuid, input.char_a_id, input.char_b_id,
    (input.relation->>'trust')::integer, (input.relation->>'intimacy')::integer, (input.relation->>'power_balance')::integer, (input.relation->>'dependence')::integer, (input.relation->>'hostility')::integer, (input.relation->>'common_goal')::integer, (input.relation->>'secret_known')::integer, (input.relation->>'emotional_bond')::integer,
    input.relation->>'relation_type', input.relation->>'relation_hierarchy', input.relation->'change_event_json', (request.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
  FROM request CROSS JOIN relation_input AS input
  LEFT JOIN existing_relations AS existing_relation
    ON existing_relation.char_a_id = input.char_a_id
   AND existing_relation.char_b_id = input.char_b_id
  WHERE existing_relation.id IS NULL
  RETURNING id
),
relation_write AS (
  SELECT id FROM relation_update
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id FROM relation_insert
),
save_response AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'correlation_id', request.value->>'correlation_id', 'result', jsonb_build_object('status', 'candidate', 'character_candidate_ids', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(id) FROM character_write), '[]'::jsonb), 'relation_candidate_ids', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(id) FROM relation_write), '[]'::jsonb), 'client_ref_map', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(character->>'client_ref', id) FROM character_input), '{}'::jsonb))) AS response
  FROM request WHERE request.value->>'action' = 'save_candidate'
),
version_response AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'correlation_id', request.value->>'correlation_id', 'result', jsonb_build_object(
    'frozen', NOT public.v7_design_editable((request.value->>'book_id')::uuid),
    'candidate', jsonb_build_object('state', 'candidate', 'characters', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) FROM public.character c JOIN public.book_project bp ON bp.id = c.book_id WHERE c.book_id = (request.value->>'book_id')::uuid AND bp.local_operator_id = (request.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid AND c.status = 'candidate' AND NOT c.is_formal AND c.is_valid AND NOT c.is_shadow), '[]'::jsonb), 'relations', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) FROM public.relation_state r JOIN public.book_project bp ON bp.id = r.book_id WHERE r.book_id = (request.value->>'book_id')::uuid AND bp.local_operator_id = (request.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid AND NOT r.is_formal AND r.is_valid AND NOT r.is_shadow), '[]'::jsonb), 'initial_memories', '[]'::jsonb),
    'formal', jsonb_build_object('state', 'formal', 'characters', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) FROM public.character c JOIN public.book_project bp ON bp.id = c.book_id WHERE c.book_id = (request.value->>'book_id')::uuid AND bp.local_operator_id = (request.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid AND c.is_formal AND c.is_valid AND NOT c.is_shadow), '[]'::jsonb), 'relations', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) FROM public.relation_state r JOIN public.book_project bp ON bp.id = r.book_id WHERE r.book_id = (request.value->>'book_id')::uuid AND bp.local_operator_id = (request.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid AND r.is_formal AND r.is_valid AND NOT r.is_shadow), '[]'::jsonb), 'initial_memories', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m)) FROM public.character_memory AS m JOIN public.character AS c ON c.id = m.char_id JOIN public.book_project AS bp ON bp.id = m.book_id WHERE m.book_id = (request.value->>'book_id')::uuid AND bp.local_operator_id = (request.value->>'local_operator_id')::uuid AND c.book_id = m.book_id AND c.is_formal AND c.is_valid AND NOT c.is_shadow AND m.is_valid AND NOT m.is_shadow), '[]'::jsonb)))) AS response
  FROM request WHERE request.value->>'action' = 'read_versions'
),
confirm_response AS (SELECT public.rpc_commit_character_settings(request.value - 'action' - 'correlation_id') AS response FROM request WHERE request.value->>'action' = 'confirm')
SELECT response FROM save_response UNION ALL SELECT response FROM version_response UNION ALL SELECT response FROM confirm_response;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ $json.response ?? { ok: false, correlation_id: $('Validate Character Command').first().json.request?.correlation_id ?? 'unavailable', error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: '角色设定服务暂时无法完成，请稍后重试。' } } }}
